controls.kind: Synthetic runner controls only; timeout process and signal actions are mocked

changes: GOWORK=off for all Go subprocesses prevents discovered workspace replacements outside the source snapshot.
A shared 35-minute normal or 12-minute research collection budget restricts each process wait and preserves workflow upload margin.
result.json starts with failed/incomplete status and is checkpointed after every scope and on collector exit.
Timeout results retain actual waited exit code and timedOut rather than claiming a pass.
Budget exhaustion records remaining scopes as unexecuted with null exit code and collectionComplete false.
Workflow job limits are 50 minutes for the expanded matrix and 20 minutes for the separate research controls; test correctness timeouts are unchanged.
review: Independent closure pending on these refinements
limits: These controls do not execute native Linux/macOS tests or prove actual boot.
Setup network operations retain their existing request timeouts; the shared process budget is not a claim of syscall preemption.
Native Mac boot, WSL, Compose, full recovery and every phase requirement remain open.
Root owns stable candidate registration, commit/push, dispatch and final evidence review.
